title: Alaska + World Skeleton
description: OpenTopoMap raster tiles. World skeleton z=0-5 (every tile globally) + Alaska statewide z=6-11 (lon -180..-130, lat 51..72). Includes the Aleutian chain. Alaska z=11 is self-rendered: vibrant color-relief extended to z11 (stock OTM goes white above z8), NO contour lines (AlaskaRouter-f7tt/xymz), corrected EPSG:3857 hillshade.

source.name: OpenTopoMap
source.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, SRTM | Map style: © OpenTopoMap (CC-BY-SA)

notes: v1: pack is bundled inside the app. v2+ will host regional packs in iCloud Drive and ship only the world skeleton in the binary. z=11 re-rendered 2026-06-10 with patch-otm-style-vibrant-z11.sh: relief-500 gate z8->z11 (ramp unchanged -- user pick), contours layer dropped. Minor roads are NOT in the raster by design: they ship as the separate vector overlay minor-roads-spike.pmtiles (AlaskaRouter-levi, raster=major/vector=minor partition, AlaskaRouter-qp29).
